postprocessing: Independent native grading preserves execution errors, timeouts and blocked delivery. A correct private staging file is not a successful delivery.
limitations: One repetition per arm; fixed model ID with stochastic inference and uncontrolled provider revisions. This does not establish a stable overall app speed or quality improvement.
Same predeclared 33 tasks, 30 eligible pairs; all 66 attempts retained, including three reference-conflict exclusions.
Four concurrent pairs, alternating arm order per pair, one CPU and 2 GiB per terminal container. Earlier runs were sequential; compare speed within this cohort, not historical wall times.
Both arms share the independent parent delivery policy and trusted host LibreOffice engine. Baseline terminal has no SheetOps CLI; candidate combines package, skill and helper changes.
Agent wall time includes runtime validation and formula calculation but excludes independent benchmark grading and native Excel calculation.
Fresh PM-built Desktop agent core via CLI, not Electron UI end-to-end. Native file-delivery routes have separate contract tests. The cohort records its frozen source commit and hashes.

The runtime freezes agent-declared scope and binds approval to exact path and bytes. It cannot establish that the declaration matches user intent or that the requested answer is correct; independent grading remains necessary.

Raw source files are graded for preservation, formulas, style and structure. Isolated Excel copies supply calculated values; originals are unchanged. Value-only outputs are parsed without a native UI open check.
Excel recovery prompts are declined and counted as invalid outputs. Unapproved outputs are retained only for failure diagnostics and never counted as delivered.
Scores use reviewed answer regions and explicit requirements, not official leaderboard scores. Provider cost is unavailable; missing token records are not zero usage.
The pilot was excluded. An explicit allowedRanges list example was added to shared runtime context before freezing this full cohort; contracts remain strict.
